description: Stand tall and steady like a mountain; root through your feet and lengthen through the crown to arrive in the present moment.
benefits: Improves posture; Builds awareness; Aligns body
insight: Let your toes soften and feel the mat—grounding invites ease.

description: Bend your knees and sit back into an invisible chair while keeping your chest bright and steady.
benefits: Strengthens legs and core; Builds heat; Improves focus
insight: Find a whisper of weight in your heels and a smile in your breath.

description: From a strong lunge, lift your chest and arms skyward, anchoring through your back heel.
benefits: Opens hips; Strengthens legs and shoulders; Builds confidence
contra: Hip or knee injury; High blood pressure (arms overhead with care)
insight: Soften the ribs to broaden the back—strength with softness.

description: Open your stance and extend through your arms, gaze calm over the front fingertips.
benefits: Builds stamina; Opens hips; Strengthens legs
insight: Feel the horizon in your fingertips—steady, spacious, present.

description: Lengthen side body from heel to fingertips, keeping the torso spacious and breath fluid.
benefits: Opens side body; Strengthens legs and core; Improves balance
insight: Keep the bottom waist long—create room for your breath.

description: Hinge at the hip and lengthen both sides of the waist as you reach top hand to the sky.
benefits: Stretches hamstrings; Opens chest; Improves balance
contra: Hamstring strain; Low blood pressure (rise slowly)
insight: Imagine the ribcage like a fan opening with each inhale.

description: Square the hips and fold over the front leg for a deep hamstring and spine lengthening.
benefits: Stretches hamstrings; Improves balance; Calms mind
insight: Keep a micro-bend in the front knee to protect the hamstring.

description: Fold from the hips with legs wide, letting the crown of the head release toward the earth.
benefits: Stretches inner thighs; Lengthens spine; Soothes nervous system
insight: Press evenly through outer edges of feet for grounded ease.

description: Drape the torso over the legs and let the neck relax; bend knees to lengthen the spine.
benefits: Relieves back tension; Calms mind; Stretches hamstrings
contra: Low back injury; Sciatica (bend knees/use blocks)
insight: Let gravity do the work; soften the jaw and eyebrows.

description: From Warrior II, flip the front palm and arc back, creating space through the side body.
benefits: Opens intercostals; Builds leg strength; Improves focus
insight: Keep your front knee tracking over toes— fluid, not forceful.

description: Sit comfortably with a tall spine and soft shoulders; invite steady, natural breath.
benefits: Calms mind; Opens hips gently; Encourages upright posture
insight: Lift the heart a touch as if smiling from the sternum.

description: Sit tall with legs extended and feet flexed, aligning head over heart, heart over hips.
benefits: Strengthens back; Improves posture; Prepares for seated folds
insight: Press thigh bones down to lift up through your spine.

description: Join the soles of the feet and let knees open like butterfly wings, spine long.
benefits: Opens hips; Eases fatigue; Supports circulation
insight: Support the outer thighs with blocks for softer release.

description: Bend one knee in and fold over the extended leg with a long spine and quiet breath.
benefits: Stretches hamstrings; Soothes nervous system; Massages organs
insight: Imagine the inhale lengthening; the exhale invites surrender.

description: Fold forward over the legs from the hips, keeping the back long and receptive.
benefits: Opens back body; Calms mind; Improves flexibility
insight: Bend knees slightly to keep length; comfort over depth.

description: Stack knees and sit evenly on sit bones, adding a gentle fold if comfortable.
benefits: Opens outer hips; Stretches glutes and IT band
insight: Use a block between feet for support and symmetry.

description: Open legs wide and fold forward with support under sit bones for lift.
benefits: Opens inner thighs; Lengthens spine; Builds patience
insight: Think of spreading the breath across the inner thighs.

description: Cross-legged with one foot to opposite thigh, maintaining knee comfort and spine length.
insight: Ease before depth—never force the knee into rotation.

description: Kneel with feet beside hips and sit back on a block to lengthen spine comfortably.
benefits: Stretches quads; Improves posture; Aids digestion
insight: Lift from navel to heart to find buoyant steadiness.

description: Balance on sit bones, lift chest and shins, and reach arms forward with steady breath.
benefits: Strengthens core and hip flexors; Improves balance
contra: Low back issues; Hip flexor strain
insight: Smile through the shake—strength grows in small sips.

description: Root through the standing foot and place the other foot on calf or inner thigh, hands at heart or overhead.
benefits: Improves balance; Strengthens legs; Builds focus
insight: Pick a drishti—still eyes invite a still mind.

description: Wrap legs and arms, sit low, and lift elbows to broaden the upper back.
benefits: Strengthens legs; Opens shoulders; Enhances concentration
insight: Lean into the hug; create spaciousness between shoulder blades.

description: Catch the foot behind and kick into the hand as chest lifts and gaze softens.
benefits: Opens chest and shoulders; Improves balance; Builds stamina
insight: Think of length before height; expansion over display.

description: Stack hips and shoulders while balancing on one leg and one hand; lift the top leg strong.
benefits: Strengthens legs; Opens hips; Improves coordination
insight: Flex the lifted foot to steady the line of energy.

description: From standing, hinge forward and extend one leg back, arms reaching forward or at sides.
benefits: Builds core strength; Improves balance; Focuses mind
insight: Imagine your body as a letter ‘T’—long, active, calm.

description: Hold big toe or use a strap to extend leg forward, standing tall through spine.
insight: Lift through the sternum; keep jaw soft.

description: Cross ankle over thigh and sit back, keeping hips level and chest lifted.
benefits: Opens outer hips; Strengthens legs; Improves focus
insight: Breathe into the outer hip to melt resistance.

description: From Tree, squat down balancing on toes and fingertips, then hands to heart.
insight: Tiny base, big breath—patience is your prop.

description: Arms extend back like wings as torso leans forward and back leg lifts.
insight: Draw shoulder heads back—heart forward, mind steady.

description: Balance on one hand and outer foot; lift hips and reach top arm skyward.
benefits: Strengthens shoulders and core; Enhances stability
insight: Press the floor away and shine through the collarbones.

description: Fold from the hips and relax the head and neck, bending knees to honor the spine.
insight: Depth is optional; tenderness is essential.

description: From a fold, lengthen spine parallel to floor with hands on shins or blocks.
benefits: Lengthens back; Prepares for forward folds
insight: Think long back, bright heart.

description: A receptive fold over extended legs with attention to breath and back body.
insight: Let the exhale be your teacher.

description: Fold over one leg with the other knee bent; spine length over depth.
insight: Keep the navel subtly turning toward the extended leg.

description: Open legs wide and hinge forward with support under sit bones.
insight: Inhale to create space; exhale to soften into it.

description: Square hips and bow over front leg, keeping both sides of waist long.
insight: Blocks under hands can turn strain into learning.

description: Same as Pyramid with reverse prayer or elbow clasp to open shoulders.
benefits: Opens chest and shoulders; Deepens hamstring stretch
insight: Let humility meet heart-opening.

description: Fold hips to heels and release forehead to mat for deep rest.
insight: Let the earth hold you—no effort required.

description: Hold opposite elbows in a soft standing fold and sway gently.
insight: Unclench the teeth; invite softness in the face.

description: From all fours, walk hands forward and melt heart toward the mat.
insight: Keep hips over knees to lengthen evenly through spine.

description: Press through hands lightly and curl the chest forward and up, shoulders soft.
insight: Length before height—lead with the heart, not the chin.

description: Elbows under shoulders, forearms grounded; broaden collarbones gently.
benefits: Gentle backbend; Opens chest; Strengthens postural muscles
insight: Press pubic bone down to protect lower back.

description: Lift chest, arms, and legs from the mat with steady neck and steady breath.
insight: Reach back through toes as you lengthen forward through crown.

description: Feet hip-width, press into heels to lift hips; interlace hands under back.
benefits: Opens chest; Strengthens glutes and hamstrings
insight: Imagine the knees moving forward to lengthen the spine.

description: Kneel and lift chest up and back, hands to heels or blocks.
insight: Keep the breath broad across the ribs—expansion with care.

description: Catch ankles and kick back into hands to lift chest and thighs.
insight: Press shins into hands to open the heart.

description: Straight arms, thighs lifted, chest forward and up, shoulders back.
insight: Root through hands to float the heart forward.

description: From supine, press into hands and feet to lift into a full backbend.
benefits: Opens whole front body; Builds strength
insight: Keep knees tracking toward toes; let breath be your guide.

description: Drop back knee and lift arms and chest, lengthening front body.
insight: Tone low belly to support the lumbar spine.

description: On all fours, inhale to arch the spine and broaden the chest.
insight: Move like honey—slow, smooth, sweet.

description: Lengthen up, then rotate gently from the navel upward.
benefits: Detoxifying sensation; Mobilizes spine; Aids digestion
insight: Lift to twist; wringing happens after lengthening.

description: Square hips and revolve the torso over the front leg, hand to block.
benefits: Strengthens legs; Opens chest; Improves balance
insight: Keep back heel heavy to stabilize the pelvis.

description: From Chair, bring palms together and twist toward the front knee.
benefits: Builds heat; Strengthens legs and core; Stimulates digestion
insight: Press palms evenly to lengthen the spine in the twist.

description: From lying down, drop knees to one side and spread arms wide.
insight: Let the exhale pool you deeper into rest.

description: From all fours, slide one arm under the other and rest on shoulder.
benefits: Opens upper back; Relieves neck tension
insight: Press the back of the hand lightly into the floor to engage.

description: From lunge, twist torso across the front thigh, hand to block or prayer.
benefits: Builds stamina; Opens chest; Strengthens legs
insight: Anchor the back heel or stay on toes—choose stability.

description: One knee bent, other leg extended; wrap and twist toward the bent knee.
insight: Gently draw low belly in to support the turn.

description: Seated twist with both knees to one side; gentle and refined.
insight: Let the collarbones smile as shoulders relax down.

description: Squat with heels lifted and wrap arms for a gentle bind if available.
benefits: Opens ankles and chest; Stimulates digestion
insight: Props under heels can turn challenge into curiosity.

description: Side bend and twist over one extended leg, top arm reaching overhead.
insight: Aim heart toward the sky, not the floor.

description: Create one strong line from heels to crown, hands under shoulders, core engaged.
benefits: Builds core and shoulder strength; Stability
insight: Spread fingers wide and press the floor away.

description: Elbows under shoulders; draw ribs in and tail long.
insight: Imagine dragging elbows toward toes—hello core.

description: Lift shins and chest, arms forward, steady breathing.
benefits: Strengthens core; Improves hip flexor endurance
insight: Shaky is okay—breathe anyway.

description: Lower legs and shoulders slightly off the mat while keeping low back grounded.
insight: Keep the back broad and the breath smooth.

description: Stack shoulders and hips; lift top arm and top leg option.
insight: Press down to lift up—energy rebounds.

description: Forearms grounded, hips lift; shoulders strengthen without wrist load.
insight: Root forearms and lengthen through spine.

description: From Down Dog, shift forward and round spine bringing knee toward nose.
insight: Exhale to round—hug belly inward.

description: Knees on triceps, lean forward and feel the weight shift into hands.
benefits: Arm balance prep; Core strength; Focus
insight: Gaze slightly forward—confidence follows vision.

description: From Boat, rotate ribs side to side with steady breath.
insight: Move from the ribs, not the arms.

description: Lift limbs with arms reaching back, legs strong and active.
insight: Find length before lift; back body smiles awake.

description: An accessible inversion that lengthens the spine and awakens the whole body.
benefits: Stretches posterior chain; Builds arm strength; Calms mind
contra: Wrist pain; High blood pressure; Glaucoma
insight: Think of the pose as a resting place between efforts.

description: Forearm down dog variation that builds shoulder stability.
benefits: Preps headstand; Strengthens shoulders and core
insight: Press forearms evenly and broaden upper back.

description: Restful inversion with hips on a bolster and legs extended up the wall.
benefits: Relaxes body; Aids circulation; Soothes nervous system
insight: Let gravity do the therapy—receive the pause.

description: Use blankets under shoulders to protect neck; lift legs skyward.
insight: Lengthen the back of the neck—never turn the head.

description: Interlace fingers, forearms grounded; practice with wall first.
insight: Progress patiently—integrity over inversion.

description: Kick up at a wall to explore alignment and confidence safely.
insight: Stack joints like blocks—hands, shoulders, hips, heels.

description: Use wall support to cultivate balance and shoulder opening.
insight: Press down to lift—your breath is the metronome.

description: Crown of head down, hips lift, hands to heels to open upper back.
insight: Keep weight mostly in knees, not the head.

description: Gentle inversion accessible to most; let the head hang heavy.
insight: A tiny bow to the day—humility is powerful.

description: From Shoulderstand, take toes toward floor or prop to reduce strain.
insight: Support the back with hands if needed—comfort is wise.

description: Bolster under torso and forehead supported for deep rest.
insight: Give yourself permission to linger.

description: Bolster along spine and props under knees for gentle heart opening.
benefits: Opens chest; Calms mind; Supports recovery
insight: Let breath cascade across the collarbones.

description: Rest legs up wall with or without bolster; eyes soft, jaw soft.
insight: Rest is productive—receive it fully.

description: Bolster or two blocks under upper back and head for a gentle chest opener.
insight: Invite breath behind the heart.

description: Knees supported on bolster as you twist gently to one side.
insight: Let exhalations lengthen naturally.

description: Lie with knees bent, feet flat; hands on belly—feel breath rise and fall.
insight: Small pauses create big clarity.

description: Bolster over thighs to rest the torso without strain.
benefits: Quiets mind; Gently stretches back body
insight: Let the forehead rest; signal safety to the body.

description: Block under sacrum; allow belly to soften and breath to deepen.
insight: Melt the back of the heart into the block.

description: Lie comfortably and release all effort, allowing the practice to integrate.
insight: Stillness is a skill—practice it with kindness.

description: Sit with support to find ease in spine and breath; eyes soft or closed.
insight: Let breath be your anchor and your compass.

description: Comfortable seat with gentle focus on breath or mantra.
insight: When the mind wanders, escort it back kindly.

description: Inhale 4, hold 4, exhale 4, hold 4; smooth and steady.
insight: Draw the square with your breath—steady and equal.

description: Balance the breath by alternating nostrils with a soft hand position.
insight: Let exhale be a shade longer to invite ease.

description: Gentle humming on exhale to soothe the mind and reduce agitation.
insight: Feel the vibration soften the space between the eyebrows.

description: Short active exhales, passive inhales; practice gently and mindfully.
insight: Keep face soft; movement is subtle at the low belly.

description: Inhale to belly, ribs, chest; exhale smoothly—layered like waves.
benefits: Expands breath capacity; Grounds the mind
insight: Place a hand on belly and heart to feel the flow.

description: Slight constriction at back of throat to create an oceanic sound.
insight: Let the sound guide your pace—steady as tides.

description: Silently repeat phrases of goodwill toward self and others.
insight: May you be safe, healthy, at ease.

description: Lie down and bring awareness systematically through body parts.
insight: Welcome everything you feel—nothing to fix.

description: Attend to the natural breath at nostrils or belly without altering it.
insight: Return to now—again and again, gently.
